evd_title: Mean correct QUADAS-2 assessment rate across four LLMs was 72.95% with Grok 3 highest at 77.27% and Gemini 2.0 Flash lowest at 67.27%
finding: Mean correct QUADAS-2 assessment rate across four LLMs was 72.95% with Grok 3 highest at 77.27% and Gemini 2.0 Flash lowest at 67.27%
P: 10 diagnostic-accuracy articles (diabetes, PubMed, 7 specialties), 11 QUADAS-2 signaling questions (110 per model)
I: Grok 3, ChatGPT 4o, DeepSeek V3, Gemini 2.0 Flash; zero-shot via web UI, PDF upload
C: 2-author expert consensus QUADAS-2 assessments; models compared
O: % correct (answer + reasoning): mean 72.95%; Grok 3 77.27%, GPT-4o 75.45%, DeepSeek 71.82%, Gemini 67.27%
T: PubMed search 9 May 2025 (most recent articles); paper 2025
